description.value: Stowel Lake Farm is a 115-acre organic farm and retreat centre on Salt Spring Island, founded by Lisa Lloyd in the mid-1970s on land originally known as the Old Reynolds Farm. It hosts wellness retreats, yoga classes, gardening workshops, and community events throughout the season, drawing guests from across BC and beyond. A Farm Stand sells farm produce to visitors, making it a potential stop for cyclists exploring the island.
